protocol.pageLifecycle: fresh isolated page per profile, mode, repetition and before/after sample
protocol.cpuScope: Complete synchronous KJP RAF callback; excludes snapshot/hash instrumentation, GPU completion and browser composition
protocol.gpuScope: Actual EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 queries only when available; no finish or busy wait
protocol.staticScope: No geometry attributes/versions/UUIDs change; no bufferData/texture/shader work after warmup; dynamic force instance bufferSubData during motion recorded separately; isolated camera orbit must upload nothing
protocol.oldRegressionThreshold: Reproducible p95 increase >10% AND >0.5ms blocks acceptance
